items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But then, when Milt died, he was totally mine, and he is really an asset.

ctx.x: Does he have the same mute as Curtis?

That soul, that sound that Curtis has. And he can read. I can write anything for him. He can play like – push my buttons. And Buster Williams and Carl Allen and Mike LeDonne, who used to be Milt Jackson’s piano player. When Milt was alive, he was playing with both of us. I used to say, “I wonder what would happen if we both had a gig on the same night? Who’s he going to play with?” He would probably play with Milt Jackson, because he was his piano player. But then, when Milt died, he was totally mine, and he is…
